mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP indicates strong economic activity, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in unemployment rate suggests a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases by >0.2pp in one month
failure_condition: If UNRATE drops but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate increases and unemployment rate decreases, it may signal economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.5% and UNRATE decreases by >0.1pp
failure_condition: If both conditions are met but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates easier monetary policy, boosting S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases but S&P 500 returns are not significantly higher.

mechanism_narrative: Increased industrial production suggests strong supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in real federal spending signals increased demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts increase and employment rises, it indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by >5% and PAYEMS increases by >10k
failure_condition: If both conditions are met but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A low and stable unemployment rate in late-cycle expansion supports positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is stable but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 35% of the time.
